invariants.text: Order.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
An order in the cancelled state cannot transition to the shipped state.
An order in the shipped state cannot transition to the cancelled state.
An order must start in the pending state.
An order in the pending state can transition to the confirmed state.
An order in the confirmed state can transition to the shipped state.
An order in the confirmed state can transition to the cancelled state.
An order in the shipped state cannot transition to the pending state.
An order in the cancelled state cannot transition to the confirmed state.
An order in the cancelled state cannot transition to the pending state.
An order in the shipped state cannot transition to the confirmed state.
